title: One sentence, every tense
subtitle: One sentence along the timeline: 6 verbs, 48 steps
label: Sentence builder
review: Written by Claude in the format of the French tense pages. Check the examples and the level.
intro: Take one short sentence along the timeline. Write each step, then compare with the model answer.

blocks.title: Read
blocks.intro: Reading a story. Start from: They read a story. Say it in each tense, then press Show answers.

items.model: They read a story every day.
They are reading a story now.
They read a story yesterday.  (it sounds like “red”)
They were reading a story at five o'clock yesterday.
They have already read a story.
They had read a story before the others arrived.
They are going to read a story tomorrow.
They will read a story later, I promise.
